# San Marcos Public Adjuster

> Licensed Texas public adjusting (Rise Public Adjusting LLC, TDI license #3356839) for homeowners and business owners in San Marcos, Hays County, and surrounding Central Texas communities. We represent policyholders, not insurance companies, on hail, wind, flood, freeze, fire, smoke, and water damage claims. Articles are written by Joseph Dittman, licensed Texas public adjuster.

Phone: +1 (832) 503-5866 · Email: info@sanmarcospublicadjuster.com
